description.text: There are 8 kinds of classes in all: Elementary A Class, Elementary B Class, Intermediate A Class, Intermediate B Class, Intermediate C Class, Advanced A Class, Advanced B Class and Advanced C Class. Application Deadline Applicants can enroll any time.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Training Program at Capital Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1277 USD/per semester ￥ 9200 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: 1.Aged under 60 years old 2.Applicant who is under 18 years old needs to submit the guardian's guarantee
